title: Controller event record (one JSON-Lines record in fades_<block>.jsonl)
description: Written by trace-rt on every controller transition, including censoring and reversion-cap hits, with the triggering quorum statistics. The RQ1 fade-event timeline and the RQ3 alignment analysis are built from this stream.

transition.description: censored = block ended mid-probe (probe incomplete). cap_reached = reversion cap hit; element pinned for the rest of the block. reduced_to_full = quorum reversion from reduced salience.

flipped_corners.description: Corners whose qualification changed on the pass that triggered this transition.

reversion_count.description: This element's probe-reversion cycles so far in this block.
